facts.fact: Sandy 早餐后看到电视播真人剧 The Stealthy Seven：六个少年侦探加一只叫 Toby 的狗，在村绿地野餐时撞破国际钻石走私团伙
facts.anchor: about six teenage sleuths and a dog named Toby who stumbled across an international diamond-smuggling ring while having a picnic on the village green

facts.fact: Sandy 确信阁楼密室与 Percival 讲 Round Robin 时的惊恐之间必有联系，只是说不清是什么联系
facts.anchor: Sandy felt that there must be some connection between the secret room and Percival’s terrified tales of Round Robin

facts.fact: Sandy 偷走 H. Hollyoak 的日记，并从其旧藏中拿走熏香与蜡烛，理由是宇宙会在紧要关头通融、自己的法器都在美国
facts.anchor: They shoved the diary under their arm and filled their pockets with incense and candles from H. Hollyoak’s old stash

facts.fact: 当天下午 Sandy 在下沉花园中央铺毯设坛：摆蜡烛、点熏香、摊开塔罗牌、把日记放在面前，并关掉手机
facts.anchor: arranged some candles and lit the incense, fanned their tarot cards out upon the ground, and placed the H. Hollyoak diary before them

facts.fact: 雾中黑影开口说 Crackers 后现形：是个棕发凌乱、雀斑脸上横贴橡皮膏的年轻女人
facts.anchor: it was a young woman with mussy brown hair and a plaster bandage across the left cheek of her freckled face

facts.fact: 来人自报家门：没人召唤得了 Georgette Downythistle，但大家都叫她 George；她只是雾天出门散步撞见傻坐在地里的怪人
facts.anchor: No one summons Georgette Downythistle—though no one calls me Georgette, everyone calls me George

facts.fact: George 约定：明天是 Tigglestide 前夜的前一天，明早雾起时她来接 Sandy、带其亲眼去见 Round Robin
facts.anchor: But tomorrow is the day before Tigglestide Eve. I’ll come get you tomorrow morning, when the fog rolls in

facts.fact: 结尾 George 骂 Sandy 又疯又痴之后，倒退着走回雾中，把 Sandy 一个人留在花园里
facts.anchor: She stepped backward and faded back into the mist, leaving Sandy all alone in the garden
